text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text: “—And here is our next story!”

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text: "Gold City, the popular Umamusume model known for being 'too gorgeous,' has announced her challenge for the Twinkle Series!"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text: "Boasting immense popularity among teenagers, it's Gold City. We can't wait to see what kind of beautiful running she'll show us today!"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text: “Now, moving on to the next segment—”

Today, full-scale training begins for Gold City.
Naturally, expectations from those around her are high
for the ultra-popular model...
choice_data_list: (I'll support them so they can shine in their races too!)

text_block_list.text: I made that vow in my heart and psyched myself up once more, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Sorry, how late am I!?
choice_data_list: It's just a little, so it'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I see...

Gold City arrived a little late for our meeting.
The atmosphere around her was somewhat tense...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, dammit... *tch*.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll finish warming up right away.
Wait for me—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that City over there?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right!
City, congratulations on your debut~~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, are you a fan of mine?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
I saw it on TV and just had to come congratulate you!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Seeing it in person is insane...! It's, like, so gorgeous—!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for the support.
But I'm starting training now, so—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ah, City's over here!
Kyaaaaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...What to do, what to do.

Oi! We can't get through here.
Make way!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
!
Tamamo-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
City, shouldn't you be trainin' too?
You really got time to be loafin' around here?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...! Sorry everyone, I've gotta go now. Come watch the race, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaa~~~~!!
Do your beeeest!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo-senpai, I'm sorry.
Thank you for helping me out.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're way too soft on your fans.
You're about to make your debut, aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Ya gotta play your cards better than that!
Catch ya later."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...To think I'd get advice from a senpai.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross-senpai. She's in a higher grade, but apparently she's debuting in the Twinkle Series this year.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So, well...
Even though you're my senior, does that make us basically classmates?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let's start training.
We're falling further and further behind schedule—
(Shudder shudder...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ngh! The manager, too...?!

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, City? Are you free right now?
It's about yesterday's photoshoot—"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I told you not to call while I'm at school! At least send a text!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Even though I made sure to tell them to let me concentrate on training... ngh.

Gold City was growing increasingly frustrated.
Starting training in this state would unlikely yield good results. And so...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —So you're telling me to just run as much as I want without thinking about anything?

I told her not to worry about distance or times,
and just run wherever her heart took her.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What's that supposed to mean? You're saying you don't plan on giving proper training to anyone who shows up late?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. Understood,
if that is your order as my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And here I wanted to train right away...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —...Ghaaaaaah!!

Gold City sprinted off as if to vent her frustration.
Recklessly, frantically looking nowhere but straight ahead, she ran—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...!
*gasp*...――
—Shining in gold, it was truly beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—...*pant*, *pant*...
Ahhh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
…………
I did.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: All that gloom I was feeling earlier just completely blew away...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ......Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Late. Mornings are seriously impossible for me...
Plus, my modeling gig yesterday was exhausting.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm the one who decided to balance both.
Making excuses on top of that would be so lame. So—
choice_data_list: Then let's keep the morning routine light!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh... Are you sure?
choice_data_list: Instead, we'll go hard this afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I mean, I'm totally down to do it, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...If you match yourself to me on everything,
I think it's gonna get super exhausting for you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't want to compromise, I'll be selfish.
And I don't plan on hiding my frustration from you either.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even if you get yelled at, or pissed off at me...
Will you still let me run?
choice_data_list: I promise that no matter what happens, I'll have you running.
I promise that no matter what happens, I'll have you running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Coming from you, that's not very reassuring.
Still... nothing starts until we believe.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get right to it,
and let me see what you've got.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Negotiate the schedule with my management. Make sure I can focus entirely on training.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You're gonna let me run with everything I've got, right?
I gotta at least be able to do this much!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I have to prove that
I'm not just some "pretty" doll
who's only good for her looks.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Show me I can count on you,
"Trainer"?
